items.title: Effects of low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections on cervicogenic dizziness-related outcomes: a randomized, sham-controlled, assessor-blinded trial.
items.summary: Low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections improved Dizziness Handicap Inventory (DHI) scores more than sham injections by -6.78 points (95% CI -8.21 to -5.36; p < 0.001) in 81 adults with cervicogenic dizziness over five weeks, though this was below the 11-point minimal important change.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT提示，对于颈源性头晕，低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射可短期改善眩晕相关残疾，但效果未达最小重要临床变化值。在将其纳入常规临床实践前，还需要与康复治疗结合并进行长期随访研究。
items.titleZh: 低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射对颈源性头晕相关结局的影响：一项随机、假对照、评估者盲法试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对81名颈源性头晕成年人的随机试验显示，低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射在五周内比假注射更能改善头晕残疾量表（DHI）总分，组间差异为-6.78分（95% CI -8.21至-5.36；p < 0.001），但仍低于11分的最小重要临床变化值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections can provide modest short-term improvements in dizziness-related disability for cervicogenic dizziness, though the benefit fell below the minimal important clinical change. Further long-term studies, ideally combined with rehabilitation, are needed before routine clinical adoption.
items.limitation: 该研究未验证受试者盲法，缺乏长期随访，且未与康复治疗联合测试，可能高估了注射的独立疗效。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked verified participant blinding, long-term follow-up, and did not test injections alongside rehabilitation, which might overestimate the independent efficacy of injections.

items.title: Aerobic and aerobic–cognitive training in knee osteoarthritis following acute exercise intensity selection: a two-phase randomised controlled trial protocol
items.summary: This two-phase randomized controlled trial protocol will investigate aerobic and aerobic-cognitive training in knee osteoarthritis, aiming to select optimal exercise intensity (55%, 65%, or 75% HRR) based on acute sensory and hemodynamic responses (N=60 in Phase I) and evaluate their efficacy against physical-agent therapy (N=108 in Phase II) on pain (primary outcome: NRS at 12 weeks).
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT方案意在找到膝骨关节炎患者有氧训练的最佳强度（55%、65%或75% HRR），并结合认知训练。若未来结果积极，你或许能为患者制定更精准的个性化运动处方，但目前仍是研究的早期阶段。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者急性运动强度选择后的有氧和有氧-认知训练：一项两阶段随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这项两阶段随机对照试验方案将研究膝骨关节炎患者的有氧和有氧-认知训练。研究旨在根据急性感觉和血流动力学反应选择最佳运动强度（I期60名受试者），并在II期评估其对疼痛（12周NRS为主要结局）的疗效，共招募108名受试者，与物理因子治疗进行比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This trial protocol aims to optimize exercise intensity for knee osteoarthritis and explore the potential of cognitive training combined with aerobic exercise. It highlights the role of pain processing, sensory responses, and brain hemodynamics in KOA rehabilitation, with future results potentially informing more personalized exercise prescriptions.
items.limitation: 作为一项试验方案，尚未获得实际结果，其结论和临床意义仍待未来研究验证。
items.limitationEn: As a trial protocol, no actual results are available yet, and its conclusions and clinical implications await future validation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A systematic review of robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation: from design to clinical evidence
items.summary: A systematic review of 19 human subject studies (2015-2025) on robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation found reported improvements in walking speed, step length, and symmetry across populations, with some studies showing reductions in metabolic cost and improved functional mobility. However, evidence for sustained clinical impact remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述总结了髋关节外骨骼机器人在步态康复中的应用进展，肯定了其在改善步速、步长和对称性方面的短期益处。它为神经康复物理治疗师提供了当前技术局限性（标准化欠缺、成本高、真实世界可转移性差）的清晰认识，指导未来在临床实践中更审慎地应用这些设备。
items.titleZh: 用于步态康复的机器人髋关节外骨骼：从设计到临床证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对19项关于机器人髋关节外骨骼步态康复研究（2015-2025）的系统综述发现，在不同人群中，步速、步长和对称性均有改善，部分研究显示代谢成本降低和功能活动度提高。然而，支持长期临床效果的证据仍有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review summarizes advancements in robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation, affirming their short-term benefits in improving walking speed, step length, and symmetry. It provides neurorehabilitation physical therapists with a clear understanding of current technical limitations (lack of standardization, high costs, poor real-world transferability), guiding more judicious application of these devices in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 尽管报告了改善，但证据主要来自短期和受控环境研究，尚缺乏支持长期临床影响的证据，且存在标准化指标和成本可及性等挑战。
items.limitationEn: Although improvements were reported, the evidence primarily comes from short-term and controlled environment studies, lacking evidence to support sustained clinical impact, and challenges such as standardized metrics and cost accessibility remain.

items.title: Comparison of Radiofrequency Microtenotomy vs. Heavy-Slow Resistance for Refractory Plantar Fasciopathy: A Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled superiority trial (N=72) comparing radiofrequency microtenotomy vs. heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy found no statistically significant between-group difference in FHSQ-DK pain change from baseline to 6 months (mean difference −4.9, 95% CI −13.8 to 4.0).
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT（N=72）明确指出，射频微创松解术与重慢阻力训练在治疗难治性足底筋膜病上，6个月时在FHSQ-DK疼痛改善方面无统计学差异。这意味着侵入性手术并不会比保守的重慢阻力训练更好，你应优先推荐患者进行重慢阻力训练，避免不必要的风险。
items.titleZh: 射频微创松解术与重慢阻力训练治疗难治性足底筋膜病的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项比较射频微创松解术与重慢阻力训练治疗难治性足底筋膜病的随机对照优效性试验（N=72）发现，从基线到6个月，FHSQ-DK疼痛变化在两组间无统计学显著差异（均数差-4.9，95% CI -13.8至4.0）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT (N=72) clearly states there was no statistically significant difference in FHSQ-DK pain improvement at 6 months between radiofrequency microtenotomy and heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy. This means invasive surgery is not superior to conservative heavy-slow resistance training; you should prioritize recommending heavy-slow resistance training to patients, avoiding unnecessary risks.
items.limitation: 研究主要结局指标（FHSQ-DK疼痛领域）未达到最小重要临床差异，可能提示两种干预的实际临床益处均有限，或测量工具的敏感性不足。
items.limitationEn: The primary outcome measure (FHSQ-DK pain domain) did not reach the minimal clinically important difference, which may suggest limited actual clinical benefits for both interventions or insufficient sensitivity of the measurement tool.

items.title: APTA State Chapters Advance Payment, Access, and Practice in 2026
items.summary: APTA state chapters secured legislative victories in 2026, advancing payment protections, expanding scope of practice, and improving patient access to physical therapy care.
items.curatedReason: APTA州分会在2026年通过立法努力，在支付、执业范围和患者可及性方面取得了显著进展。这凸显了持续的政策倡导对于物理治疗行业的重要性，提示美国地区的物理治疗师，积极参与或支持专业协会的立法工作，是推动执业环境改善的关键。
items.titleZh: APTA 州分会在2026年推动支付、准入和执业取得进展
items.summaryZh: APTA各州分会在2026年取得了立法胜利，在支付保护、执业范围扩大和改善患者获得物理治疗服务方面取得了进展。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA state chapters achieved significant legislative progress in 2026 across payment, scope of practice, and patient access. This highlights the importance of sustained policy advocacy for the physical therapy profession, suggesting that physical therapists in the US should actively participate in or support professional association legislative efforts as a key driver for improving practice environments.

items.title: APTA Report: Demand for PTs and PTAs Is Outpacing Workforce Growth
items.summary: A new APTA report reveals that in 2026, outpatient physical therapy practices saw an 11% workforce growth but a nearly 25% increase in job openings, indicating that demand for PTs and PTAs is significantly outpacing workforce growth.
items.curatedReason: APTA的报告指出，2026年物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理的需求增长远超劳动力增长，凸显了行业日益增长的服务缺口。这提示物理治疗机构和执业者，应重视人才招聘和保留策略，并思考如何优化现有资源以应对不断扩大的患者需求。
items.titleZh: APTA 报告：物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理需求增长超越劳动力增长
items.summaryZh: 一份新的APTA报告显示，2026年门诊物理治疗机构的劳动力增长了11%，但职位空缺增加了近25%，表明对物理治疗师（PT）和物理治疗师助理（PTA）的需求显著超过了劳动力增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's report indicates that in 2026, the demand for physical therapists and physical therapist assistants significantly outpaced workforce growth, highlighting a widening service gap in the profession. This suggests that physical therapy practices and practitioners should prioritize recruitment and retention strategies and consider how to optimize existing resources to meet increasing patient demand.

items.title: Reported Approaches to Vaginal Pessary Use for Treating Pelvic Organ Prolapse in Women: A Secondary Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 14 RCTs on vaginal pessary use for pelvic organ prolapse (POP) found significant variation and incompleteness in reporting intervention components across TIDieR domains, hindering reproducibility in clinical practice. Only one study reported all TIDieR domains.
items.curatedReason: 这项二次分析强调了目前盆腔器官脱垂（POP）阴道子宫托干预RCTs报告细节的不足，影响了其在临床实践中的可复制性。它提醒临床物理治疗师和研究者，未来试验应更全面地描述子宫托的类型、使用方法和联合治疗，以提高证据质量和转化效率。
items.titleZh: 女性盆腔器官脱垂阴道子宫托使用方法报告分析：随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对盆腔器官脱垂（POP）阴道子宫托使用的14项RCT的二次分析发现，干预措施的报告在TIDieR领域存在显著差异和不完整性，影响了临床实践的可复制性。仅一项研究报告了所有TIDieR领域。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis highlights inadequate reporting of vaginal pessary intervention details in current RCTs for pelvic organ prolapse (POP), hindering reproducibility in clinical practice. It reminds physical therapists and researchers to comprehensively describe pessary types, usage, and combined treatments in future trials to enhance evidence quality and translation.
items.limitation: 该研究关注的是RCTs中子宫托干预报告的完整性，而非干预本身的疗效，因此不能直接提供子宫托治疗POP的临床证据强度。
items.limitationEn: This study focused on the completeness of reporting pessary interventions in RCTs, not the efficacy of the interventions themselves, so it does not directly provide clinical evidence strength for pessary treatment of POP.

items.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction Symptoms in Peruvian Women, 2025
items.summary: A national cross-sectional study of 1280 Peruvian women in 2025 found a PFD symptom prevalence of 40.1% (95% CI 35.8–44.6). Older age (aPR 3.47 for 55–64 years), multiparity (aPR 1.62), grand multiparity (aPR 1.72), and macrosomic newborn history (aPR 1.22) were independently associated with higher prevalence.
items.curatedReason: 这项秘鲁的横断面研究提供了盆底功能障碍（PFD）症状的流行病学数据及其关联因素。它提示我们，在拉美地区，老年、多产和巨大儿分娩史是PFD的高风险因素，支持了对高危人群进行主动筛查和预防性盆底护理的必要性。
items.titleZh: 2025年秘鲁女性盆底功能障碍症状的流行率及相关因素
items.summaryZh: 一项2025年针对秘鲁1280名女性进行的全国横断面研究发现，盆底功能障碍症状的流行率为40.1%（95% CI 35.8–44.6）。老年（55-64岁调整后患病率比3.47）、多产（调整后患病率比1.62）、高产次（调整后患病率比1.72）和巨大儿分娩史（调整后患病率比1.22）与较高的流行率独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Peruvian cross-sectional study provides epidemiological data on pelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) symptoms and associated factors. It suggests that older age, multiparity, and a history of macrosomic newborns are high-risk factors for PFD in Latin America, supporting the need for active screening and preventive pelvic floor care in at-risk populations.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系；且症状评估基于患者自述问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and symptom assessment relies on self-reported questionnaires, which may involve recall bias.

items.title: Knee joint biomechanical characteristics of table tennis players based on inertial sensing technology: impact on LESS-defined risk stratification for anterior cruciate ligament injury
items.summary: In 68 table tennis players, inertial measurement units identified a peak knee valgus angle of 15.62 ± 3.48° in the high-risk ACL injury group (LESS score ≥ 5) versus 9.28 ± 2.56° in the low-risk group (p < 0.001), with an optimal cutoff of 12.5° (AUC 0.860) for distinguishing risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用惯性传感技术识别了乒乓球运动员在步停任务中过度的膝外翻角度是ACL损伤高风险的关键生物力学指标。它为运动物理治疗师提供了一种非侵入性的风险评估工具和明确的生物力学干预目标，有助于更早期地识别高危运动员并制定针对性预防方案。
items.titleZh: 基于惯性传感技术的乒乓球运动员膝关节生物力学特征：对LESS定义的ACL损伤风险分层的影响
items.summaryZh: 在68名乒乓球运动员中，惯性测量单元发现，高风险ACL损伤组（LESS评分≥5）的膝关节峰值外翻角度为15.62 ± 3.48°，而低风险组为9.28 ± 2.56°（p < 0.001），最佳区分风险的临界值为12.5°（AUC 0.860）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study used inertial sensing technology to identify excessive knee valgus angle during a step-stop task as a key biomechanical indicator of high ACL injury risk in table tennis players. It provides sports physical therapists with a non-invasive risk assessment tool and clear biomechanical intervention targets, aiding earlier identification of high-risk athletes and development of targeted prevention programs.
items.limitation: 该研究为横断面观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且ACL损伤风险评估基于LESS评分，而非实际损伤发生率，可能存在局限性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional observational study, unable to establish causality. ACL injury risk assessment was based on the LESS score, not actual injury incidence, which might be a limitation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of medial arch-support and double-density foot orthoses on median frequency of lower limb muscles during walking among cohorts at different postoperative timepoints after ACL reconstruction
items.summary: A study of 40 men (30 ACLR patients, 10 healthy controls) found that medial arch-support and double-density foot orthoses significantly modulated EMG median frequency of lower limb muscles during walking, with effects most pronounced in early postoperative (6-month) ACLR groups with pronated feet.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对40名男性的观察研究表明，内侧足弓支撑和双密度鞋垫能显著调节ACL重建术后下肢肌肉的EMG中值频率，尤其在术后6个月内、伴有足部旋前的患者中效果更明显。这提示你可以考虑将特定鞋垫作为ACL重建术后早期康复的辅助手段，以优化神经肌肉活动。
items.titleZh: 内侧足弓支撑和双密度鞋垫对ACL重建术后不同时间点患者行走时下肢肌肉中位频率的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对40名男性（30名ACL重建患者，10名健康对照）的研究发现，内侧足弓支撑和双密度鞋垫在行走时显著调节了下肢肌肉的EMG中位频率，且这种效应在早期术后（6个月）伴有扁平足的ACL重建组中最为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 40 men indicates that medial arch-support and double-density foot orthoses significantly modulate lower limb muscle EMG median frequency after ACLR, with effects more pronounced in early postoperative (6-month) patients with pronated feet. This suggests you might consider specific orthoses as an adjunct in early ACLR rehabilitation to optimize neuromuscular activity.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，而非纵向随访，无法直接反映个体康复进程中鞋垫的长期效果或 biomechanical 对齐的直接证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, not a longitudinal follow-up, and therefore cannot directly reflect the long-term effects of orthoses or direct evidence of biomechanical alignment during individual recovery.

items.title: Creating Consensus: Establishing a Definition of Sports Pharmacy and Its Emerging Role in Sports Medicine
items.summary: The US Sports Pharmacy Group established the first consensus-derived definition of sports pharmacy, emphasizing medication management, anti-doping advocacy, interprofessional collaboration, and athlete-centered ethical care, aiming to guide future education, certification, and research.
items.curatedReason: 这份关于运动药学的共识声明，首次明确定义了运动药学的范畴和职责，强调了药物管理、反兴奋剂倡导和跨专业协作的重要性。虽然直接影响物理治疗实践有限，但它为运动医学多学科团队的协作提供了清晰的界定，提示物理治疗师在团队中与其他专业（包括运动药师）进行更有效的沟通与配合。
items.titleZh: 建立共识：定义运动药学及其在运动医学中的新兴作用
items.summaryZh: 美国运动药学小组首次确立了运动药学的共识定义，强调药物管理、反兴奋剂倡导、跨专业协作和以运动员为中心的伦理护理，旨在指导未来的教育、认证和研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus statement on sports pharmacy is the first to clearly define its scope and responsibilities, emphasizing medication management, anti-doping advocacy, and interprofessional collaboration. While its direct impact on physical therapy practice is limited, it provides a clear delineation for multidisciplinary sports medicine teams, encouraging physical therapists to engage in more effective communication and collaboration with other professionals, including sports pharmacists, within the team.

items.title: Exploring association patterns among muscle mass, gait speed, and upper- and lower-limb muscle strength in sarcopenic and non-sarcopenic swiss community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional secondary analysis using portable, field-ready assessments
items.summary: A cross-sectional secondary analysis of 198 older adults (17 sarcopenic) found that lower-limb strength (LLSmax) correlated more strongly with ALM/height² in sarcopenic participants (ρ = 0.79) than upper-limb strength (ULSmax) (ρ = 0.53), while the opposite trend was observed in non-sarcopenic individuals. Gait speed was not significantly associated with any measure in the sarcopenic group.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对瑞士社区老年人的横断面分析，探讨了便携式评估工具在肌少症筛查中肌量、步速和上下肢肌力之间的关联模式。它提示下肢肌力与肌少症患者的肌量关联更强，支持在社区筛查中重视下肢肌力评估，但需更多研究验证便携式工具的诊断价值。
items.titleZh: 瑞士社区老年人肌少症与非肌少症人群中肌量、步速及上下肢肌力关联模式的探索：一项使用便携式现场评估工具的横断面二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对198名老年人（17名肌少症患者）的横断面二次分析发现，在肌少症患者中，下肢肌力（LLSmax）与附肢瘦体重/身高²的关联（ρ = 0.79）强于上肢肌力（ULSmax）（ρ = 0.53），而在非肌少症个体中则观察到相反的趋势。步速在肌少症组中与任何测量指标均无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional analysis of Swiss community-dwelling older adults explores association patterns between muscle mass, gait speed, and upper and lower limb muscle strength using portable assessment tools for sarcopenia screening. It suggests a stronger association between lower limb muscle strength and muscle mass in sarcopenic individuals, supporting the emphasis on lower limb strength assessment in community screening, but requires further research to validate the diagnostic value of portable tools.
items.limitation: 这是一项二次分析的横断面研究，样本量中肌少症亚组较小（N=17），且无法建立因果关系，其探索性发现应谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary cross-sectional analysis with a small sarcopenic subgroup (N=17) and cannot establish causality; its exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Wearable activity-sequence measures and subsequent handgrip strength in adults aged 65 years and older: measurement characteristics and longitudinal associations
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 391 adults aged 65+ found that a run-collapsed LZ76 activity-sequence measure was associated with subsequent handgrip strength (β = 0.906 kg/SD, p = 0.016, ΔR²=0.00301), while H1–H3 conditional entropy showed an imprecise association. Both measures demonstrated good within-wear agreement (ICCs of 0.775 and 0.876).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对391名65岁以上老年人的纵向研究发现，可穿戴设备记录的LZ76活动序列指标与随后的手握力相关（β=0.906 kg/SD）。这意味着你除了关注总活动量，还应留意老年患者日常活动的序列模式，这可能提供更精细的体能评估依据。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴活动序列指标与65岁及以上成人手握力的后续关联：测量特征和纵向关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对391名65岁以上成年人的纵向研究发现，一种名为run-collapsed LZ76的活动序列测量指标与随后的手握力相关（β = 0.906 kg/SD, p = 0.016, ΔR²=0.00301），而H1-H3条件熵则显示出不精确的关联。这两项指标均显示出良好的穿戴内一致性（ICC分别为0.775和0.876）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This longitudinal study of 391 adults aged 65+ found that the LZ76 activity-sequence measure from wearables was associated with subsequent handgrip strength (β=0.906 kg/SD). This means you should pay attention to the temporal patterns of daily activity in older patients, beyond just total activity volume, as it may offer more refined insights for physical assessment.
items.limitation: 研究部分结果的统计学显著性不强，且某些探索性分析是在初始结局分析后进行的，可能存在偏倚，需要更多独立验证。
items.limitationEn: Some results of the study lack strong statistical significance, and certain exploratory analyses were conducted after initial outcome analyses, which may introduce bias and require further independent validation.

items.title: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review of 43 studies found acute hypoxic exposure did not lower Wingate Anaerobic Test performance unless severe (FiO2 ~ 0.104) or repeated. Prolonged chronic exposure (≥30 days, high altitude) decreased performance by 2-8%. Intermittent exposure-based training likely benefits performance when combined with long-duration (≥90 min) exercise.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述总结了低氧暴露和训练方法对Wingate无氧测试表现的影响，发现急性或慢性严重低氧可能会降低表现，但间歇性低氧训练结合长时间运动可能带来益处。这提示运动物理治疗师在设计高强度训练方案时，应审慎考虑低氧训练的类型和剂量，避免在特定情况下对无氧能力产生负面影响。
items.titleZh: 低氧暴露和训练方法对Wingate测试表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对43项研究的系统综述发现，除非在严重低氧（FiO2约0.104）或重复进行的情况下，急性低氧暴露不会降低Wingate无氧测试表现。长期慢性暴露（≥30天，高海拔）会使表现下降2-8%。间歇性低氧训练结合长时间（≥90分钟）运动可能有利于提高表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review summarizes the effects of hypoxic exposure and training methods on Wingate anaerobic test performance, finding that acute or chronic severe hypoxia may decrease performance, but intermittent hypoxic training combined with long-duration exercise might offer benefits. This suggests that sports physical therapists, when designing high-intensity training programs, should carefully consider the type and dose of hypoxic training to avoid negative impacts on anaerobic capacity in specific situations.
items.limitation: 综述的结论依赖于纳入研究的质量，且对于不同低氧暴露方案和人群的异质性较大，难以得出普适性的最佳训练建议。
items.limitationEn: The conclusions of the review rely on the quality of included studies, and there is significant heterogeneity across different hypoxic exposure protocols and populations, making it difficult to draw universally optimal training recommendations.

items.title: Acute effects of fibular repositioning taping on balance, jumping, and sprint performance in healthy individuals: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A three-arm RCT (N=90 healthy adults) found fibular repositioning taping (FRT) did not significantly differ from sham taping in Y-Balance performance, but showed greater short-term improvements in single-leg countermovement jump and 10-m sprint compared to both sham and control groups. These secondary findings were exploratory.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现，腓骨复位贴扎（FRT）在急性期可改善健康个体的单腿反向跳跃和10米冲刺表现，但对Y平衡测试的改善与假贴扎无显著差异。这提示FRT可能对某些动态运动表现有短期促进作用，但在平衡改善方面证据不强，物理治疗师应根据具体临床目标审慎应用。
items.titleZh: 腓骨复位贴扎对健康个体平衡、跳跃和冲刺表现的急性影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（N=90名健康成人）发现，腓骨复位贴扎（FRT）在Y平衡表现上与假贴扎无显著差异，但在单腿反向跳跃和10米冲刺方面，FRT组比假贴扎组和对照组有更大的短期改善。这些次要发现为探索性结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that fibular repositioning taping (FRT) acutely improved single-leg countermovement jump and 10-m sprint performance in healthy individuals, but showed no significant difference from sham taping in Y-Balance test improvement. This suggests FRT might offer short-term benefits for some dynamic athletic performances, but evidence for balance improvement is not strong. Physical therapists should apply it judiciously based on specific clinical goals.
items.limitation: 研究为回顾性注册，且主要结局Y平衡测试与假贴扎无显著差异，次要结局的发现是探索性的，需要进一步的确认性研究。
items.limitationEn: The study was retrospectively registered, and the primary outcome (Y-Balance test) showed no significant difference from sham taping. Secondary findings are exploratory and require further confirmatory studies.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Acute muscle responses to a single session of whole-body electromyostimulation in sedentary older men: a pilot study
items.summary: A pilot study with seven sedentary older men found a single WB-EMS session led to transient reductions in knee extensor MVIC and handgrip strength, with recovery by 72h. Muscle soreness increased, peaking at 24-72h. Muscle thickness and echo intensity showed transient increases in vastus medialis and biceps brachii.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点研究发现，单次全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）对久坐老年男性是安全且耐受的，并能引起肌肉力量的短期下降及可逆性肌肉反应。它提示WB-EMS可能作为一种低负荷的训练和康复策略，但其长期益处和最佳方案仍需进一步的大规模研究来明确。
items.titleZh: 单次全身电肌肉刺激对久坐老年男性急性肌肉反应的试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对七名久坐老年男性的试点研究发现，单次全身电肌肉刺激导致膝伸肌最大自主收缩力和握力短暂下降，并在72小时内恢复。肌肉酸痛增加，在24-72小时达到峰值。股内侧肌和肱二头肌的肌肉厚度和回声强度均出现短暂增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study found that a single session of whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) was safe and well-tolerated in sedentary older men, inducing transient reductions in muscle strength and reversible muscle responses. It suggests WB-EMS as a potential low-load training and rehabilitation strategy, but its long-term benefits and optimal protocols require further large-scale studies.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（N=7）的试点研究，无法得出强有力的结论，且仅评估了急性肌肉反应，未涉及长期功能或力量改善。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample (N=7) pilot study, precluding strong conclusions, and it only assessed acute muscle responses without addressing long-term functional or strength improvements.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Validation of Video-based Motion Capture for Lower Body and Trunk Kinematics with Marker Augmentation
items.summary: This study validates video-based motion capture with marker augmentation for assessing lower body and trunk kinematics, suggesting its utility in rehabilitation and performance analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了基于视频的运动捕捉技术结合标记物增强，在评估下肢和躯干运动学方面的有效性。它提示了这种技术在未来临床和运动康复中进行步态分析和生物力学评估的潜力，尤其是在传统实验室设备受限的情况下。
items.titleZh: 视频运动捕捉结合标记物增强验证下肢和躯干运动学
items.summaryZh: 本研究验证了结合标记物增强的视频运动捕捉技术在评估下肢和躯干运动学方面的有效性，提示其在康复和运动表现分析中的应用潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates video-based motion capture with marker augmentation for lower body and trunk kinematics, indicating its potential for gait analysis and biomechanical assessment in clinical and sports rehabilitation, particularly where traditional lab equipment is limited.
items.limitation: 研究未提供具体的验证数据和结果，难以判断其在临床或运动环境中的实际应用精度与可靠性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not provide specific validation data and results, making it difficult to assess its actual accuracy and reliability for clinical or sports applications.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Association Between Borg CR-10 Rated Perceived Exertion and Cardiorespiratory Intensity in Individuals with Coronary Heart Disease: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated the association between Borg CR-10 Rated Perceived Exertion and cardiorespiratory intensity in individuals with coronary heart disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了冠心病患者Borg CR-10感知运动量表与心肺强度关联的横断面数据。它强化了Borg量表作为一种便捷、非侵入性工具，在心肺康复中指导运动强度设定的实用性，特别是在资源有限或需要自我管理的场景下。
items.titleZh: Borg CR-10感知运动量表与冠心病患者心肺强度关联的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究探讨了冠心病患者的Borg CR-10感知运动量表与心肺强度之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides cross-sectional data on the association between Borg CR-10 RPE and cardiorespiratory intensity in coronary heart disease patients. It reinforces the utility of the Borg scale as a convenient, non-invasive tool for guiding exercise intensity in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, especially in resource-limited or self-managed settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚，影响了Borg量表在不同时间点的应用准确性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and may suffer from recall bias, affecting the accuracy of Borg scale application at different time points.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: One-year prevalence and factors associated with injury in Japanese collegiate American footballers - a cross-sectional observational survey study
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 896 Japanese collegiate American footballers found a 1-year injury prevalence of 62%. Factors associated with higher injury odds included higher university year, greater sport experience, five or more practice days per week, national level of play, and athletic trainer support.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对日本大学美式橄榄球运动员的横断面研究提供了该人群损伤流行率和相关因素的独特数据。它提示我们需关注高年级、经验丰富、训练频率高、国家级水平运动员的损伤预防，并强调运动训练师支持的重要性，有助于制定更精准的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 日本大学美式橄榄球运动员损伤一年流行率及相关因素：一项横断面观察性调查研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对896名日本大学美式橄榄球运动员的横断面调查发现，一年内损伤流行率为62%。与较高损伤几率相关的因素包括大学高年级、运动经验更丰富、每周训练五天或以上、国家级比赛水平以及运动训练师支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study on Japanese collegiate American footballers provides unique data on injury prevalence and associated factors in this population. It highlights the need to focus on injury prevention for senior, experienced, high-frequency training, and national-level athletes, emphasizing the importance of athletic trainer support, which can inform more precise intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且数据依赖于自我报告问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and data relies on self-reported questionnaires, which may involve recall bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: APTA, NSCA Return-to-Play Summit Highlights Rehab, Performance
items.summary: The APTA and NSCA hosted a Return-to-Play Performance Summit, bringing together rehabilitation and performance professionals to advance education and foster interprofessional connections.
items.curatedReason: APTA与NSCA的联合峰会，体现了物理治疗与体能训练专业在重返运动领域的协同。这强化了多学科合作的重要性，提示物理治疗师在为运动员提供康复和表现提升服务时，应积极寻求与其他专业人士的协作机会。
items.titleZh: APTA、NSCA 重返赛场峰会强调康复与体能表现
items.summaryZh: APTA与NSCA联合举办了一场重返赛场表现峰会，汇集了康复和体能专业人士，旨在促进教育和加强跨专业联系。
items.curatedReasonEn: The joint APTA and NSCA summit highlights the synergy between physical therapy and strength and conditioning professions in return-to-play. This reinforces the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration, suggesting physical therapists should actively seek opportunities to collaborate with other professionals when providing rehabilitation and performance enhancement services to athletes.

items.title: 3D Biomechanics of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injuries in Football: What We Have Learned in the Last Five Years.
items.summary: This review synthesizes over five years of research on 3D biomechanics of ACL injuries in elite male football players, identifying a sequence of multiplanar knee rotations and marked inter-individual variability in whole-body kinematics, proposing biomechanically informed injury mitigation strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述提醒我们，ACL 损伤不仅仅是单一平面的问题，而是复杂的膝关节多平面旋转序列。更重要的是，它强调了显著的个体差异，提示我们在预防和康复中必须超越“一刀切”的方案，转向针对个体全身姿态的精细化策略。
items.titleZh: 足球中前交叉韧带损伤的 3D 生物力学：过去五年我们学到了什么
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述综合了过去五年精英男子足球运动员 ACL 损伤 3D 生物力学的研究，确定了膝关节多平面旋转的序列和全身运动的显著个体差异，并提出了基于生物力学的损伤缓解策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clarifies that ACL injuries involve a complex sequence of multiplanar knee rotations, not just isolated movements. Crucially, it highlights significant inter-individual variability, underscoring that our prevention and rehabilitation strategies must move beyond 'one-size-fits-all' and become more nuanced, especially regarding context-dependent whole-body postures.
items.limitation: 该综述基于对已发生损伤的运动学重建，可能存在回顾性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The review is based on kinematic reconstructions of existing injuries, which may introduce retrospective bias.

items.title: Previewing gaze behaviours predict gait speed, risky stepping strategies and cognitive dual task cost in older adults
items.summary: A study of 29 older adults found that greater gaze sequence complexity during route previewing predicted lower cognitive dual-task cost during walking, while larger gaze transitions predicted slower walking speed, suggesting visual planning impacts locomotor and cognitive outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 29 名老年人的观察研究提示，他们预习路线时的视线模式与步行表现和认知负荷相关。这表明，优化视觉策略，比如引导患者在行走前更有效地规划视线，可能有助于降低双任务成本并提升步速，尤其值得你在步态训练中尝试。
items.titleZh: 老年人预览注视行为预测步态速度、风险步态策略和认知双任务成本
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 29 名老年人的研究发现，路线预览期间较高的注视序列复杂性预示着步行时较低的认知双任务成本，而较大的注视转换预示着较慢的步行速度，这表明视觉规划会影响运动和认知结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 29 older adults suggests that their gaze patterns during route previewing correlate with subsequent walking performance and cognitive load. It implies that optimizing visual strategies—perhaps by training patients to plan their gaze more effectively before walking—could reduce dual-task costs and improve walking speed. This is certainly worth exploring in your gait training protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=29），结果可能难以广泛推广。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=29), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Efficacy of action observation therapy in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of nine RCTs (n=348) found action observation therapy significantly improved cognitive function (SMD = 0.86, 95% CI = 0.53 to 1.19), activities of daily living (SMD = 0.67, 95% CI = 0.22 to 1.12), and naming aphasia (SMD = 0.53, 95% CI = 0.01 to 1.05) in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment.
items.curatedReason: 动作观察疗法对痴呆或认知障碍患者的认知功能、ADL 和命名性失语有显著改善作用。这为认知康复提供了强有力的非药物干预选择。
items.titleZh: 动作观察疗法对痴呆或认知障碍患者的疗效：一项随机试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 9 项随机对照试验（n=348）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，动作观察疗法显著改善了痴呆或认知障碍患者的认知功能（SMD = 0.86，95% CI = 0.53 至 1.19）、日常生活活动（ADL）（SMD = 0.67，95% CI = 0.22 至 1.12）和命名性失语（SMD = 0.53，95% CI = 0.01 至 1.05）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Action observation therapy significantly improved cognitive function, ADL, and naming aphasia in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment. This offers a strong non-pharmacological intervention option for cognitive rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量和样本量存在异质性，可能影响结果的总体稳健性。
items.limitationEn: There was heterogeneity in methodological quality and sample size among the included studies, potentially impacting the overall robustness of the results.

items.title: Exploratory analysis of the impact of age stratification on outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy in pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip using a 3-year cutoff.
items.summary: A retrospective study of 65 pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) patients found that those under 3 years old receiving combined Salter and femoral osteotomy showed superior radiographic and functional outcomes (e.g., McKay excellent/good rates: 97.1% vs 64.5%) and lower avascular necrosis risk (0% vs 12.9%) compared to patients aged 3 years or older, with a mean follow-up of 8 ± 2.5 years.
items.curatedReason: 对发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）患儿，3 岁以下接受 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术联合治疗的患者，功能结局和股骨头坏死（AVN）风险可能优于 3 岁及以上的患儿。这支持早期干预的价值。
items.titleZh: 年龄分层对儿童发育性髋关节发育不良联合 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术疗效影响的探索性分析（以 3 年为分界点）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 65 名儿童发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）患者的回顾性研究发现，3 岁以下接受 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术联合治疗的患者，其影像学和功能结局（如 McKay 优良率：97.1% vs 64.5%）以及股骨头坏死（AVN）风险（0% vs 12.9%）均优于 3 岁及以上的患者，平均随访时间为 8 ± 2.5 年。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), those under 3 years receiving combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy may have better functional outcomes and lower avascular necrosis (AVN) risk than those aged 3 years or older. This supports the value of early intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，存在固有偏倚，且多变量回归的估计值不稳定，不能确证年龄的独立效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective study with inherent biases, and the unstable estimates from multivariable regression preclude confirmation of an independent age effect.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation applied simultaneously with exercise therapy in patellofemoral pain: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blind, randomized pilot trial (n=30) found no additional short-term benefit of neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) combined with exercise therapy for pain, function, or quadriceps strength in patellofemoral pain, compared to exercise with sham stimulation. A small increase in quadriceps muscle thickness was observed in the NMES group (p = .03, Cohen's d = -0.27).
items.curatedReason: 对髌股疼痛患者，电刺激联合运动疗法在短期内未显示出额外益处，除了股四头肌厚度的小幅增加。避免将 NMES 作为常规辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 髌股疼痛患者同时施加神经肌肉电刺激联合运动疗法的效果：一项单盲、随机、假对照试点试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲、随机试点试验（n=30）发现，对髌股疼痛患者，与假刺激相比，神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）联合运动疗法在短期内对疼痛、功能或股四头肌力量没有额外益处。NMES 组观察到股四头肌厚度小幅增加（p = .03，Cohen's d = -0.27）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patellofemoral pain patients, NMES combined with exercise therapy showed no additional short-term benefits beyond a small increase in quadriceps muscle thickness. Avoid routine use of NMES as an adjunct.
items.limitation: 这是一项小型试点研究，仅有 30 名参与者，可能无法检测出小到中等效应量的真实差异。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot trial with only 30 participants, potentially underpowered to detect small to moderate effect sizes.

items.title: Satisfaction with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation in people with Parkinson's disease and its association with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life: a longitudinal national register study.
items.summary: A longitudinal national register study (n=173) in Sweden found that over 82% of Parkinson's disease patients were satisfied with outpatient rehabilitation. Higher satisfaction was associated with greater life satisfaction and health-related quality of life at discharge, with some associations differing by sex and age, though these links were less evident at 1-year follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 高满意度与出院时的生活满意度和健康相关生活质量相关，但长期随访中这种关联减弱。这提示您，衡量患者康复体验和报告结局至关重要，尤其是在帕金森病康复中。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者对医院门诊康复的满意度及其与生活满意度及健康相关生活质量的关联：一项纵向国家登记研究
items.summaryZh: 一项瑞典国家纵向登记研究（n=173）发现，超过 82% 的帕金森病患者对门诊康复满意。较高的满意度与出院时更高的生活满意度和健康相关生活质量相关，某些关联因性别和年龄而异，但在 1 年随访时这些关联减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: High satisfaction was associated with life satisfaction and HRQoL at discharge, but this link weakened at 1-year follow-up. This suggests that measuring patient rehabilitation experiences and reported outcomes is crucial, especially in Parkinson's disease rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项基于瑞典国家登记数据的观察性研究，可能存在未测量的混杂因素影响结果。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study based on Swedish national register data, and unmeasured confounders might influence the results.

items.title: Patients treated with rehabilitation alone after anterior cruciate ligament injury display greater muscle strength symmetry, yet lower absolute muscle strength normalized to bodyweight compared to reconstruction: A Cross-sectional study of 3,093 patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 3,093 patients found that those treated with rehabilitation alone for ACL injury had greater muscle strength symmetry but lower absolute muscle strength normalized to bodyweight compared to the ACL reconstruction group.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型横断面研究提示，单纯康复治疗的 ACL 损伤患者，肌力对称性更好，但绝对肌力（矫正体重后）低于重建组。评估非手术路径时，请注意权衡这种差异。
items.titleZh: 3,093 例患者的横断面研究：ACL 损伤后仅接受康复治疗者比重建者显示出更好的肌力对称性，但绝对肌力（矫正体重后）更低
items.summaryZh: 一项对 3,093 例 ACL 损伤患者的横断面研究显示，仅接受康复治疗的患者在所有随访中肌力对称性更好，但除了 10 周时的覥绳肌力外，未受伤肢体的绝对肌力（体重标准化后）均低于重建组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cross-sectional study suggests that ACL injury patients treated with rehabilitation alone exhibit better muscle strength symmetry but lower absolute strength (normalized to bodyweight) compared to the reconstruction group. When evaluating non-operative pathways, consider this trade-off.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且患者分组受年龄和活动水平影响，存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality, and patient grouping was influenced by age and activity level, introducing selection bias.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review of qualitative evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of eight qualitative studies identified key factors influencing healthcare professionals' promotion of physical activity in persons with MS, emphasizing the need for MS-specific education, practical resources, and cross-sector coordination.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述揭示了医疗专业人员在促进 MS 患者体育活动方面的障碍和需求。你的执业可以考虑纳入 MS 特异性教育、患者资源和多部门协作，以提高康复效果。
items.titleZh: 医疗专业人员对多发性硬化症患者体育活动促进的看法和经验：一项定性证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 8 项定性研究的系统综述确定了影响医疗专业人员促进多发性硬化症（MS）患者体育活动的关键因素，强调需要 MS 特异性教育、实用资源和跨部门协作。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights the barriers and needs of healthcare professionals in promoting physical activity for MS patients. Your practice should consider incorporating MS-specific education, patient resources, and cross-sector coordination to enhance rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 系统综述纳入的研究均为定性研究，其发现的整合受到研究异质性和方法学限制。
items.limitationEn: The systematic review included only qualitative studies, and the synthesis of findings is subject to heterogeneity and methodological limitations.

items.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Oropharyngeal Alignment Exercise on Swallowing Function in Neurological Disorders with Restricted Mouth Opening: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A single-arm pilot study involving 9 participants with neurological disorders found that oropharyngeal alignment exercises were feasible and well-tolerated, showing preliminary improvements in swallowing function and maximum mouth opening (6-13 mm increase).
items.curatedReason: 对于神经系统疾病患者，口咽对齐练习（OAE）在小样本（9人）中展现了改善吞咽和张口度（6-13毫米）的潜力。尽管只是初步观察，但其可行性和耐受性良好，提示你可以考虑将其作为现有康复方案的补充。
items.titleZh: 口咽对齐练习对神经系统疾病伴有限制性张口患者吞咽功能的初步可行性及效应：一项预研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 9 名神经系统疾病患者的单臂预研究发现，口咽对齐练习（OAE）可行且耐受性良好，初步观察到吞咽功能和最大张口度有改善，最大张口度增加了 6-13 mm。
items.curatedReasonEn: For neurological patients, oropharyngeal alignment exercises (OAE) showed preliminary promise in improving swallowing and mouth opening (6-13 mm) in a small pilot study of 9. While exploratory, its feasibility and tolerability suggest you might consider it as an adjunct to existing rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂前瞻性设计研究，样本量小（9 人），且缺乏对照组，限制了结果的普遍性和因果推断。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-arm prospective pilot study with a small sample size (9 participants) and lacked a control group, limiting the generalizability of the findings and causal inference.

items.title: Neurorehabilitation as an Opportunity for Structured Post-Stroke Lipid Management: A Narrative Review.
items.summary: A narrative review suggests that neurorehabilitation offers a practical approach to strengthen secondary stroke prevention by integrating supervised medication titration, adherence monitoring, and patient-centered secondary prevention strategies for lipid management.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述提醒我们，神经康复可能是强化卒中后血脂管理的关键环节。作为康复医师，你可以探索如何将药物滴定、依从性监测和患者教育整合到你的康复计划中。
items.titleZh: 神经康复作为卒中后结构化血脂管理的机会：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述提出，神经康复提供了一个加强卒中二级预防的实际方法，可通过将监督下的药物滴定、依从性监测和以患者为中心的二级预防策略整合到康复中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review highlights neurorehabilitation as a crucial opportunity to strengthen post-stroke lipid management. As a rehabilitation clinician, explore how to integrate medication titration, adherence monitoring, and patient education into your rehabilitation plan.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，基于现有证据的总结，但缺乏直接的康复干预随机对照试验来支持其建议。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, summarizing existing evidence, but it lacks direct rehabilitation-based randomized trials to support its recommendations.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Return to Olympic Medal Performance Following Morphology-Informed and Criterion-Based Nonoperative Management of a Femoral-Sided Sherman Type II ACL Injury - A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report details an elite field hockey player who achieved Olympic silver-medal performance after a femoral-sided Sherman Type II ACL injury with morphology-informed nonoperative management and criterion-based rehabilitation, challenging the necessity of reconstruction for elite athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这个个案报告振奋人心，它颠覆了高水平运动员 ACL 损伤必须手术重建的传统观念。在特定 ACL 形态（股骨侧 Sherman II 型）的精英运动员中，严格的非手术管理和基于标准的康复也能帮助他们重返奥运赛场，这意味着你和外科医生在处理这类损伤时，有理由探索更多非手术路径。
items.titleZh: 超越重建：股骨侧 Sherman II 型 ACL 损伤经形态学指导和基于标准的非手术管理后重返奥运奖牌表现——一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份病例报告详细介绍了一名精英曲棍球运动员在股骨侧 Sherman II 型 ACL 损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复治疗，最终获得了奥运银牌的表现，这挑战了精英运动员 ACL 损伤必须重建的传统观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This inspiring case report challenges the dogma that elite athletes with ACL injuries always require surgical reconstruction. For select elite athletes with favorable ACL morphology (femoral-sided Sherman Type II), rigorous non-operative management and criterion-based rehab can lead to Olympic-level return to play. This means you have grounds to explore more non-surgical pathways with surgeons when managing similar injuries.
items.limitation: 这是一份单病例报告，其发现不具备普遍性，不能推广到其他运动员或 ACL 损伤类型。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and its findings are not generalizable to other athletes or types of ACL injuries.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Network-Based Brain Stimulation: Targeting the Frontoparietal Network for Cognitive Rehabilitation After Stroke Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 RCTs found that non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) targeting the frontoparietal network significantly improved executive function (Hedges' g = 0.48), working memory (g = 0.41), and attention (g = 0.38) in stroke survivors, with superior outcomes when combined with cognitive training.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后认知障碍患者，可以考虑将非侵入性脑刺激（NIBS）与认知训练结合。这项对 21 项 RCT 的系统综述表明，这种干预能中等程度改善执行功能、工作记忆和注意力，效果比单用 NIBS 更好。
items.titleZh: 基于网络的脑刺激：靶向额顶叶网络用于卒中后认知康复的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 21 项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，靶向额顶叶网络的非侵入性脑刺激（NIBS）显著改善了卒中幸存者的执行功能（Hedges' g = 0.48）、工作记忆（g = 0.41）和注意力（g = 0.38），且与认知训练结合时效果更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke survivors with cognitive impairment, integrating non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) with cognitive training is a viable option. This systematic review of 21 RCTs indicates a moderate improvement in executive function, working memory, and attention, with better outcomes than NIBS alone.
items.limitation: 现有证据主要来自短期试验，且不同研究的 NIBS 刺激参数和方案存在异质性，长期临床效用尚需标准化、影像学引导的进一步研究来验证。
items.limitationEn: Existing evidence is mainly from short-term trials, and NIBS stimulation parameters and protocols vary across studies. Long-term clinical utility requires further standardized, neuroimaging-guided research for validation.

items.title: Newsroom Articles | CMS
items.summary: CMS released the 2027 Medicare Part A and Part B premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance on November 17, 2026, and also issued the proposed Comprehensive Regulations to Uncover Suspicious Healthcare (CRUSH) rule on November 16, 2026, aimed at strengthening program integrity and saving nearly $90 billion over 10 years by targeting fraud, waste, and abuse.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了 2027 年 Medicare A/B 部分的保费和免赔额，并提出了 CRUSH 规则以打击医保欺诈。这些政策直接影响美国 PT 执业的报销环境和合规性要求，你必须密切关注以调整未来的执业和运营策略。
items.titleZh: CMS 新闻稿：2027 年 Medicare 保费与 CRUSH 反欺诈拟议规则
items.summaryZh: CMS 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日发布了 2027 年 Medicare A 部分和 B 部分的保费、免赔额和共同保险，并于 2026 年 11 月 16 日发布了拟议的《综合规定以揭露可疑医疗保健》（CRUSH）规则，旨在加强项目完整性，并通过打击欺诈、浪费和滥用在 10 年内节省近 900 亿美元。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released 2027 Medicare Part A/B premiums and deductibles and proposed the CRUSH rule to combat healthcare fraud. These policies directly impact reimbursement and compliance requirements for PT practice in the US, and you must pay close attention to adjust future practice and operational strategies.

items.title: Comparative diagnostic utility of SPECT-CT versus MRI and CT in chronic low back pain.
items.summary: In a retrospective cohort of 122 patients with chronic low back pain, SPECT-CT positivity was moderately and independently associated with Modic changes, advanced Pfirrmann grade, and vacuum disc/facet phenomena on MRI/CT, but findings were frequently discordant, suggesting SPECT-CT may complement other imaging.
items.curatedReason: SPECT-CT 与 MRI/CT 在慢性腰痛诊断中的关联度中等，但代谢和结构发现并非可互换。在疼痛管理中考虑 SPECT-CT 作为辅助工具时，请记住其临床效用（即能否识别症状水平）仍需结果验证。
items.titleZh: SPECT-CT 对比 MRI 和 CT 在慢性腰痛中的诊断效用：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 122 例慢性腰痛患者的回顾性队列研究显示，SPECT-CT 阳性与 MRI/CT 上的 Modic 改变、Pfirrmann 晚期分级、椎间盘真空征和椎小关节真空征存在中度独立关联，但影像学结果常不一致，提示 SPECT-CT 可作为其他影像学检查的补充。
items.curatedReasonEn: SPECT-CT shows moderate association with MRI/CT findings in chronic low back pain, but metabolic and structural findings are not interchangeable. When considering SPECT-CT as an adjunct in pain management, remember its clinical utility—i.e., whether it identifies symptomatic levels—still requires outcome-based validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性单中心队列研究，且仅关注 SPECT-CT 阳性与结构性退行性病变的关联，未验证其与患者症状改善或功能预后的直接关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective single-center cohort study focused only on the association between SPECT-CT positivity and structural degenerative findings, without validating its direct relationship with patient symptom improvement or functional prognosis.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with limb loss 2-years after the 2023 Kahramanmaras-Türkiye earthquakes
items.summary: A retrospective analysis of children (mean 13.7 years) with earthquake-related limb loss 2.3 years post-amputation showed favorable child-reported PedsQL scores (median 72.3/100.0) for physical, social, and school domains, but lower emotional functioning (60.0/100.0), indicating the importance of long-term mental health support.
items.curatedReason: 在土耳其地震后两年，肢体缺失儿童的躯体、社交和学业相关生活质量良好，但情绪健康仍受影响。在长期康复管理中，你必须将心理健康支持与假肢适配和康复服务并重。
items.titleZh: 2023 年卡赫拉曼马拉什-土耳其地震后两年肢体缺失儿童的躯体和心理社会结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对地震相关肢体缺失儿童（平均年龄 13.7 岁）在截肢后 2.3 年的回顾性分析显示，儿童报告的 PedsQL 身体、社交和学业领域评分良好（中位数 72.3/100.0），但情绪功能较低（60.0/100.0），这凸显了长期心理健康支持的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Two years after the Turkey earthquakes, children with limb loss show favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life, but emotional well-being remains affected. In long-term rehabilitation management, you must prioritize mental health support alongside prosthetic fitting and rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，缺乏对照组，且数据来自单一中心，可能存在选择偏倚和结果的外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective analysis lacks a control group and data are from a single center, potentially introducing selection bias and limiting the generalizability of results.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Fake nurse given good behaviour bond following Ahpra prosecution
items.summary: A Queensland woman was placed on a $2500 good behaviour bond and ordered to pay $1750 in legal costs by Ahpra for falsely claiming to be a registered nurse while employed as an Assistant in Nursing and in a teacher aide application, highlighting the regulator's strong stance against misrepresentation of professional qualifications.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一名女子因谎称注册护士而被判守行保释，这再次提醒你，医疗执业者必须如实反映其资历和注册状态。在澳大利亚执业的物理治疗师应意识到 AHPRA 对虚假陈述注册情况的零容忍立场，以避免类似的法律后果。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局：假冒护士被判守行保释
items.summaryZh: 一名昆士兰女子因在担任助理护士期间和申请教师助理职位时谎称自己是注册护士，被澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）判处 2500 澳元守行保释，并需支付 1750 澳元法律费用，这凸显了监管机构对虚报专业资质的严厉立场。
items.curatedReasonEn: An Australian woman received a good behavior bond for falsely claiming to be a registered nurse, serving as a reminder that healthcare practitioners must truthfully represent their qualifications and registration status. Physical therapists practicing in Australia should be aware of AHPRA's zero-tolerance stance on misrepresenting registration to avoid similar legal consequences.

items.title: The effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on lower-limb function after total knee arthroplasty: a randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: A single-center RCT (n=128) found that integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation modestly improved Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) scores at postoperative week 4 (difference +1.55 points, 95% CI 0.02-3.07, P=0.047) after TKA, and TUGT scores at weeks 8 and 12, but without significant differences in 6MWT, pain, or ROM.
items.curatedReason: 膝关节置换术（TKA）后，将髋踝训练整合到常规康复中，在早期（术后 4 周）可适度改善下肢功能，并在术后 8-12 周改善活动能力（TUGT）。在常规康复方案中，可以考虑在患者接受度高的情况下增加多关节训练，以期获得这些中期功能益处。
items.titleZh: 多关节下肢训练对全膝关节置换术后下肢功能的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（n=128）发现，将髋踝训练整合到常规康复中，可适度改善全膝关节置换术（TKA）后下肢功能量表（LEFS）得分（术后 4 周，差异 +1.55 分，95% CI 0.02-3.07，P=0.047），并在第 8 和 12 周改善 TUGT 分数，但在 6MWT、疼痛或关节活动度方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: After total knee arthroplasty (TKA), integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation modestly improves early lower-limb function (at 4 weeks post-op) and mobility (TUGT) at 8-12 weeks. You may consider adding multi-joint training to conventional rehabilitation when patient acceptance is high, aiming for these mid-term functional benefits.
items.limitation: 尽管早期 LEFS 有统计学差异，但临床意义阈值未达到，且优势在术后 12 周已不明显；研究主要关注短期结果，缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: Although early LEFS showed statistical significance, it did not meet the clinically important threshold, and the advantage was not evident by week 12. The study primarily focused on short-term outcomes, lacking long-term follow-up data.

items.title:
XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 24 studies found XR serious games to show preliminary benefit in reducing phantom limb pain (AR-based systems with d = 0.9–1.3), improving functional mobility (VR exergames in 2 RCTs), and supporting prosthesis control and embodiment after amputation, with mechanistic evidence for cortical adaptation.
items.curatedReason: XR 严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛、改善功能移动性、支持假肢控制和增强截肢后本体感方面显示出初步益处。在康复实践中，你可将其视为现有疗法的有效补充，特别是在处理幻肢痛和促进皮层适应性方面，但仍需关注其在现实世界的应用和可扩展性。
items.titleZh: XR 严肃游戏对幻肢痛、神经功能恢复和假肢采纳的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 24 项研究的系统综述发现，XR 严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛（基于 AR 的系统效应量 d = 0.9–1.3）、改善功能移动性（2 项 RCT 中的 VR 运动游戏），以及支持截肢后假肢控制和本体感方面显示出初步益处，并提供了皮层适应的机制性证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: XR serious games show preliminary benefits in reducing phantom limb pain, improving functional mobility, supporting prosthesis control, and enhancing embodiment after amputation. In rehabilitation practice, you may consider them an effective adjunct to existing therapies, especially for phantom limb pain and cortical adaptation, while noting the need for further research on real-world implementation and scalability.
items.limitation: 尽管 XR 游戏效果显著，但证据主要来自小型研究和探索性发现，缺乏大规模、高质量的 RCT，且在现实世界中的实施和可扩展性仍需更多研究。
items.limitationEn: Despite significant effects, evidence for XR games is mainly from small studies and exploratory findings, lacking large-scale, high-quality RCTs, and further research is needed on real-world implementation and scalability.

items.title: Aqua Steps: A Feasibility Study of a new Aquatic Exercise Therapy Intervention for Falls Prevention in Older Adults.
items.summary: A feasibility study of a new aquatic exercise intervention (Aqua Steps) with 101 older adults at high falls risk found high feasibility and acceptability. It reduced falls by 38%, fallers by 36%, and frequent fallers by 58%, with significant improvements in functional (22%-70%) and strength (10%-80%) tests.
items.curatedReason: Aqua Steps 水中运动干预对高跌倒风险老年人的跌倒预防显示出高可行性和初步积极效果。作为一种安全且受欢迎的替代方案，你可以将其作为陆上运动的补充或替代选择，特别是在平衡和力量训练方面具有潜在优势。
items.titleZh: Aqua Steps：一项针对高跌倒风险老年人跌倒预防的新型水中运动疗法干预的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 101 名高跌倒风险老年人的新型水中运动干预（Aqua Steps）可行性研究显示，该方案可行性高、接受度好，并使跌倒发生率降低 38%，跌倒者减少 36%，频繁跌倒者减少 58%，功能（22%-70%）和力量（10%-80%）测试均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Aqua Steps aquatic exercise intervention shows high feasibility and promising preliminary effects for falls prevention in older adults at high risk. As a safe and popular alternative, you can consider it as a complementary or alternative option to land-based exercises, especially for its potential benefits in balance and strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，虽然显示出初步积极效果，但样本量有限（101 名老年人），未进行随机对照，需要大规模 RCT 来确证其在跌倒预防中的长期有效性。
items.limitationEn: This feasibility study, while showing promising preliminary effects, had a limited sample size (101 older adults) and was not a randomized controlled trial. A large-scale RCT is needed to confirm its long-term effectiveness in falls prevention.

items.title: Who am I now? Experienced changes of occupational identity after spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with six adults explored the dynamic process of redeveloping occupational identity after spinal cord injury, revealing uncertainty and transformation influenced by daily activities and environmental contexts.
items.curatedReason: 对脊髓损伤患者来说，职业认同的重建是康复的关键一环。这项小样本定性研究提示，支持患者探索新的自我价值和人生叙事，能帮助他们更好地应对身份转变，尤其要关注日常活动和环境对其职业认同的影响。
items.titleZh: 我是谁？脊髓损伤后职业认同变化的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 6 名脊髓损伤成人进行的定性访谈研究发现，患者在重建职业认同过程中经历了不确定性和动态转变，受日常活动和环境因素影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Redeveloping occupational identity is crucial for individuals with spinal cord injury. This small qualitative study suggests that supporting patients in exploring new self-worth and life narratives can help them navigate identity transformation, with particular attention to how daily activities and environmental contexts influence their occupational identity.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（6 名成人），结果主要为探索性发现，不具备普适性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study with a small sample size (six adults) provides exploratory findings that are not generalizable.

items.title: Does Hemiplegic Side Matter? A Cross-Sectional Study of Laterality Impacts on Mobility, Balance, Hand Dexterity, and Cognition in Stroke Patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 51 first-ever stroke patients found that left hemiplegic patients showed reduced functional mobility, poorer postural control, increased fall risk, and reduced impaired hand dexterity compared to right hemiplegic patients, while exhibiting higher cognitive scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明卒中偏瘫侧对患者的活动能力、平衡、手部灵巧性和认知有显著影响。在制定康复策略时，你应针对患者的偏瘫侧特异性缺陷进行定制化干预。
items.titleZh: 偏瘫侧有影响吗？一项横断面研究探讨卒中患者偏瘫侧对活动能力、平衡、手部灵巧性和认知的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 51 名首次卒中患者的横断面研究发现，左侧偏瘫患者的功能活动能力、姿势控制和跌倒风险较右侧偏瘫患者差，受损手灵巧性降低但认知得分更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that the hemiplegic side in stroke patients significantly impacts mobility, balance, hand dexterity, and cognition. When developing rehabilitation strategies, you should tailor interventions to side-specific deficits.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，样本量为 51 名首次卒中患者，且仅在短期内观察，结果尚不能推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study with 51 first-ever stroke patients was observed only for a short period, and its results cannot infer causality.

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: A non-randomized controlled pilot study (60 caregiver-child dyads) found a 6-week family-centered gardening intervention feasible and well-accepted for preschoolers with developmental delays, improving social functioning (mean change, 3.34; p = .007) but not sensory integration or caregiver outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性研究提示，以家庭为中心的互动式园艺干预可作为支持发育迟缓学龄前儿童社会参与的补充方法。虽然对感觉统合和照护者相关结局无显著影响，但其可行性和可接受性高，并改善了儿童的社会功能，值得你在早期干预中考虑。
items.titleZh: 互动式园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童的影响：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 60 对亲子进行的非随机对照预试验发现，为期 6 周的家庭中心园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童可行且接受度高，改善了社会功能（平均变化 3.34；p = .007），但对感觉统合和照护者结局无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study suggests that an interactive, family-centered gardening intervention can serve as a complementary approach to support social participation in preschoolers with developmental delays. While showing no significant impact on sensory integration or caregiver-related outcomes, its high feasibility and acceptability, coupled with improved child social functioning, warrant consideration in early intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照预试验，样本量有限（60 对亲子），随访期短（6 周），对感觉统合和照护者结局无显著改善，需要更大规模的 RCT 来确证其长期效果。
items.limitationEn: This non-randomized controlled pilot study has a limited sample size (60 caregiver-child dyads) and a short follow-up period (6 weeks), showing no significant improvements in sensory integration or caregiver outcomes. Larger RCTs are needed to confirm long-term effects.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study (n=41 participants classified as fallers and 122 non-fallers) found Timed Up and Go Test (TUG, AUC=0.777) and Four Square Step Test (FSST, AUC=0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls in older adults, but no single test was sufficient. Combining tests with fall history significantly improved model fit (bootstrap-corrected AUC 0.89-0.97).
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，在社区老年人跌倒风险评估中，TUG 和 FSST 具有最佳的预测判别力，但单一测试不足以可靠预测未来跌倒。将这些功能测试与跌倒史结合，能显著提高预测模型的准确性，你应在临床实践中综合运用。
items.titleZh: 功能活动度测试在预测老年人跌倒风险中的效力
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名跌倒者和 122 名非跌倒者进行的前瞻性观察性队列研究发现，TUG（AUC=0.777）和 FSST（AUC=0.771）在预测跌倒风险方面判别力最高，但单一测试不足。将测试与跌倒史结合可显著改善模型拟合（bootstrap 校正 AUC 0.89-0.97）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that TUG and FSST offer the best predictive discrimination for fall risk in community-dwelling older adults, though no single test is sufficiently reliable. Combining these functional tests with fall history significantly improves prediction model accuracy, so you should use them in combination in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，包括 41 名跌倒者和 122 名非跌倒者，并且其模型改善结果是探索性的，需要外部验证才能推及更广泛人群。
items.limitationEn: This observational study of 41 participants classified as fallers and 122 non-fallers had exploratory model improvement results that require external validation for broader applicability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Injury risk and physical therapy utilization following knee surgery in U.S. Army soldiers: a comparison of military and non-military treatment facilities.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 4924 U.S. Army soldiers found that those undergoing knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities (32% of cohort) had higher subsequent injury rates (79% vs. 73%) and longer physical therapy duration (8.3 vs. 7.1 weeks; p = 0.038) compared to those treated at military facilities.
items.curatedReason: 美军士兵膝关节手术后若在非军事医疗机构就医，再受伤风险更高，物理治疗时长也更长。这提示 PT 执业者评估患者预后时要考虑其治疗环境。
items.titleZh: 美军士兵膝关节手术后受伤风险与物理治疗利用率：军事与非军事医疗机构的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项对 4924 名美军士兵的回顾性队列研究显示，在非军事医疗机构接受膝关节手术的士兵（占队列的 32%）再受伤率更高（79% vs. 73%），物理治疗持续时间也更长（8.3 vs. 7.1 周；p = 0.038）。
items.curatedReasonEn: U.S. Army soldiers receiving knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities face higher re-injury risk and longer PT duration. This suggests PTs should consider treatment setting when assessing patient prognosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, limiting causal inference and potentially subject to unmeasured confounders.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Effectiveness of a Structured Post-Platelet Rich Plasma Rehabilitation Approach on Pain and Function in Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=54) for subacromial pain syndrome found that adding a structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved pain (VAS: 2.92 vs. 7.96; SF-MPQ: 10.07 vs. 19.37; p < 0.001), muscle strength, range of motion, and shoulder function compared to conventional physiotherapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 对肩峰撞击综合征患者，在常规物理治疗基础上增加结构化 PRP 术后康复方案，能在短期内带来更好的疼痛缓解和功能改善。但在推广前，还需长期随访数据。
items.titleZh: 富血小板血浆（PRP）注射后结构化康复方案对肩峰撞击综合征患者疼痛与功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对肩峰撞击综合征的随机对照试验（n=54）发现，在常规物理治疗基础上增加结构化 PRP 术后康复方案，与仅接受常规物理治疗相比，可显著改善疼痛（VAS：2.92 vs. 7.96；SF-MPQ：10.07 vs. 19.37；p < 0.001）、肌肉力量、活动范围和肩关节功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: For subacromial pain syndrome, adding a structured post-PRP rehabilitation to conventional physiotherapy yields superior short-term pain reduction and functional improvement. However, long-term follow-up is needed before widespread adoption.
items.limitation: 研究未进行长期随访，观察到的改善是否持续尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked long-term follow-up, so the sustainability of observed improvements remains unclear.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=50) in stroke patients found that visual feedback balance training (ProKin-252) led to a statistically greater improvement in Berg Balance Scale (adjusted difference of 1.43 points, 95% CI, 0.37-2.49; p = .009) and fear of falling compared to robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait), with both showing improvements in functional mobility and gait speed.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的平衡和步态康复中，视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin）在平衡能力和跌倒恐惧方面优于机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait），但两者在步态和整体功能上差异不显著。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练与视觉反馈平衡训练对卒中患者平衡和步态结局的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对卒中患者的随机对照试验（n=50）发现，与机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait）相比，视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin-252）在 Berg 平衡量表评分（调整后差异 1.43 分，95% CI, 0.37-2.49；p = .009）和跌倒恐惧方面有统计学上更显著的改善，两者在功能移动和步速上均有提高。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients' balance and gait rehabilitation, visual feedback balance training (ProKin) showed superiority over robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait) in balance and fear of falling, though no significant differences were found in gait or overall functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 调整后的 Berg 平衡量表分数差异（1.43 分）虽具统计学意义，但临床意义可能相对有限。
items.limitationEn: The adjusted Berg Balance Scale difference (1.43 points), while statistically significant, may have limited clinical meaningfulness.

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study analyzing 8,533 pediatric rehabilitation referrals found an overall service initiation rate of 42.7%. Key barriers included geographic availability, scheduling challenges, how professionals communicate service needs, prior rehabilitation experience, competing family priorities, financial/transportation issues, and a "wait and see" approach.
items.curatedReason: 儿科康复服务的启动率仅 42.7%，地理可及性、排班、费用、交通和专业人士沟通方式都是家长面临的障碍。你需要关注这些社会人口学差异，优化转诊沟通，以提高服务可及性。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8,533 份儿科康复转诊的混合方法研究发现，总体服务启动率仅为 42.7%。主要障碍包括地理可及性、排班挑战、专业人士沟通服务需求的方式、既往康复经验、家庭优先事项冲突、财务/交通问题以及“观望”态度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric rehabilitation service initiation rates are only 42.7%, with barriers including geographic availability, scheduling, cost, transportation, and communication by professionals. You need to address these sociodemographic disparities and optimize referral communication to improve service access.
items.limitation: 研究的定性部分样本量较小（12 位家长），可能无法完全代表所有非启动案例的复杂性。
items.limitationEn: The qualitative component had a small sample size (12 parents), which may not fully represent the complexity of all non-initiation cases.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation

items.title: Individualized systems-informed corrective exercise for adults meeting prespecified criteria for upper crossed syndrome: protocol for a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This is a protocol for a parallel randomized controlled trial (n=36) to examine the added effect of a structured, individualized, staged corrective-exercise program for adults with upper crossed syndrome. Both groups will receive stationary cycling, indication-based stretching, mobilization, and education, with the intervention group adding a systems-informed corrective program.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 协议将评估针对上交叉综合征的个体化、系统知情纠正性运动方案，能否在常规治疗基础上带来额外益处。如果你关注这种常见姿势问题的干预，可以留意未来结果。
items.titleZh: 针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人：系统知情纠正性运动的随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这是一项平行随机对照试验（n=36）的方案，旨在评估针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人，结构化、个体化、分阶段的纠正性运动方案所带来的额外效果。两组都将接受固定自行车、基于适应症的牵伸和松动以及健康运动习惯教育，干预组在此基础上增加系统知情纠正性方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol will assess if an individualized, systems-informed corrective exercise program for upper crossed syndrome provides added benefits beyond conventional therapy. If you treat this common postural issue, keep an eye on future results.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际研究结果公布。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and no actual research results have been published yet.

items.title: VRCycle: A Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating a Virtual Reality Cycling Intervention in People With Knee Osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A two-arm feasibility RCT with 41 knee osteoarthritis participants found that VR-enhanced cycling was highly feasible and acceptable, with 91% adherence and 90% retention. Both VR-enhanced and traditional cycling showed within-group improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity, supporting progression to a full efficacy trial.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性 RCT 表明，VR 辅助骑行对膝骨关节炎患者可行且可接受，初步疗效与传统骑行相似。这支持了将 VR 融入膝 OA 康复方案的进一步研究。
items.titleZh: VRCycle：一项评估虚拟现实骑行干预对膝骨关节炎患者可行性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名膝骨关节炎患者进行的双臂可行性随机对照试验发现，VR 辅助骑行具有高度可行性和可接受性，依从性达 91%，留存率达 90%。VR 辅助骑行和传统骑行均在组内疼痛、功能和运动能力方面显示改善，支持进一步开展全面疗效试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility RCT suggests that VR-enhanced cycling is feasible and acceptable for knee osteoarthritis patients, with preliminary efficacy similar to traditional cycling. This supports further research into integrating VR into knee OA rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小，未设功效以评估疗效，因此不能得出确切的治疗效果结论。
items.limitationEn: As a feasibility study with a small sample size, it was not powered to evaluate efficacy, thus definitive conclusions on treatment effects cannot be drawn.

items.title: Effects of adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy on postural responses and autonomic function in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT with 30 MS patients found that adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy reduced response latency in specific postural tests (Adaptation Test toes-down: p = .034; Motor Control Test back-small: p = .006), but showed no significant between-group differences at any time point or for autonomic function.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，颅骶疗法（CST）作为多发性硬化症传统理疗的辅助手段，可能对特定姿势反应参数产生影响。但在更大的患者群体中，其对姿势控制和自主神经功能的明确优越性仍需更多研究验证。
items.titleZh: 颅骶疗法作为辅助手段对多发性硬化症患者姿势反应和自主神经功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名多发性硬化症患者进行的单盲随机对照试验发现，颅骶疗法作为传统理疗的辅助手段，在特定姿势测试（适应性测试脚趾朝下：p = .034；运动控制测试背部小肌：p = .006）中缩短了反应潜伏期，但任何时间点或自主神经功能方面均未显示显著组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that craniosacral therapy (CST) as an adjunct to conventional physiotherapy in MS might influence specific postural response parameters. However, its definitive superiority for postural control and autonomic function in a larger patient population requires further validation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（30 人），且未显示颅骶疗法对自主神经功能的显著治疗效果，限制了结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (30 participants) and lack of significant treatment effect on autonomic function for craniosacral therapy limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Physical calibration and signal periodic updates to synchronize IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking
items.summary: A study with 15 volunteers demonstrated that combining physical calibration with signal-based periodic updates effectively synchronized wearable IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking, achieving high correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees) compared to motion capture, enabling accurate real-world kinematic monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 对膝关节屈曲的长期、连续性运动学追踪，这项方法在真实世界中有可能实现。这项小样本研究提示，你也许能通过物理校准与信号更新结合的方式，让可穿戴 IMU 系统达到长达 5 天的精确度，相关性 (r ≥ 0.971) 和 RMSD (≤ 6.2 度) 都表现不错。
items.titleZh: 用于 5 天连续膝关节屈曲跟踪的 IMU 物理校准和信号周期性更新同步方法
items.summaryZh: 一项涉及 15 名志愿者的研究表明，将物理校准与基于信号的周期性更新相结合，可有效同步可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU），实现长达 5 天的膝关节屈曲连续跟踪。与运动捕捉相比，该方法实现了高相关性（r ≥ 0.971）和低均方根差（RMSD ≤ 6.2 度），从而实现准确的真实世界运动学监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Long-term, continuous kinematic tracking of knee flexion might be achievable in real-world settings with this method. This small-sample study suggests you could achieve accurate 5-day tracking with wearable IMU systems by combining physical calibration with signal updates, showing good correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees).
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康志愿者，在临床患者人群中，长期穿戴 IMU 的依从性和同步精度可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on healthy volunteers; adherence to long-term IMU wear and synchronization accuracy in clinical patient populations may require further validation.

items.title: Cellular health beyond body composition: phase angle suitability for breast cancer patients undergoing physical training: a randomised trial
items.summary: A randomized trial with 37 breast cancer patients found no significant between-group differences in phase angle (PhA) or body composition between home-based and hospital-supervised high-intensity training. Changes in PhA (p < 0.0001), BMI (p = 0.0377), fat mass (p = 0.0387), and muscle mass (p = 0.0449) were primarily treatment-dependent, supporting structured home-based exercise and PhA as an independent cellular health marker.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对乳腺癌患者而言，无论是居家运动还是医院监督下的高强度训练，身体成分和血参数的变化主要取决于化疗而非运动模式。这意味着你可以更灵活地为乳腺癌患者开具运动处方，同时相位角（PhA）可作为细胞和代谢状态的独立指标。
items.titleZh: 身体成分之外的细胞健康：相位角在接受体育训练的乳腺癌患者中的适用性：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 37 名乳腺癌患者进行的随机试验发现，居家运动组和医院监督下高强度训练组在相位角（PhA）或身体成分方面没有显著组间差异。相位角（p < 0.0001）、BMI（p = 0.0377）、脂肪量（p = 0.0387）和肌肉量（p = 0.0449）的变化主要与治疗相关，支持结构化居家运动和将 PhA 作为独立的细胞健康标志物。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that for breast cancer patients, changes in body composition and blood parameters are primarily chemotherapy-dependent, not exercise modality-dependent, for both home-based and supervised high-intensity training. This implies greater flexibility in prescribing exercise for breast cancer patients, with phase angle (PhA) serving as an independent indicator of cellular and metabolic status.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（37 人），且居家组和医院组在训练监督强度和环境上存在差异，可能影响结果的可比性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (37 participants), and differences in supervision intensity and environment between home-based and hospital-based groups may affect comparability of results.

items.title: Increasing Efficiency in Resistance Training? Exploring a Minimalistic Approach in Supramaximal Accentuated Eccentric Loading: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes evidence on supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL), indicating its potential to promote strength gains with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week) due to high eccentric mechanical stimulus. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are sparse, and evidence on physiological adaptations primarily comes from eccentric-only training.
items.curatedReason: 超最大离心负荷 (SAEL) 训练在提高力量方面可能有效，即便训练容量很低（每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）。如果你在寻找一种高机械刺激、低训练量的方案，这可能值得尝试。但请注意，目前与传统阻力训练的直接比较研究还很有限。
items.titleZh: 提高阻力训练效率？探索超最大离心负荷中的极简主义方法：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述综合了超最大离心负荷（SAEL）的证据，表明其通过高离心机械刺激，有望以低训练量（例如，每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）促进力量增长。然而，与传统阻力训练的直接比较稀少，且生理适应性证据主要来自纯离心训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: Supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL) training may be effective for strength gains, even with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week). If you're looking for a high mechanical stimulus with low training volume, this might be worth exploring. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are still sparse.
items.limitation: 该综述是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且大部分证据来自高强度离心训练而非 SAEL 干预本身，缺乏与传统阻力训练的直接比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias, and much of the evidence is derived from high-intensity eccentric-only training rather than SAEL interventions, lacking direct comparisons with traditional resistance training.

items.title: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summary: This review highlights blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a strategy to address exercise intolerance in COPD and other populations. BFR allows low-load exercise (20–40% 1RM) to achieve strength gains comparable to high-load training, offering a solution for improving peripheral muscle function when exertional dyspnoea or other limitations restrict high-intensity training.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述阐述了血流限制（BFR）训练在 COPD 患者肺康复中的潜力，以及如何将其从临床扩展到居家环境。它提醒你，对于运动不耐受或无法进行高负荷训练的患者，BFR 训练能以低负荷实现与高负荷相似的力量和耐力增益，是改善外周肌肉功能、克服呼吸困难限制的有效策略。
items.titleZh: 事半功倍：血流限制训练在 COPD 和其他疾病中的应用，从临床到居家
items.summaryZh: 本综述强调血流限制（BFR）训练是一种解决 COPD 及其他人群运动不耐受的策略。BFR 允许低负荷运动（20-40% 1RM）实现与高负荷训练相当的力量增益，为当劳力性呼吸困难或其他限制阻碍高强度训练时，改善外周肌肉功能提供了一种解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review elucidates the potential of blood flow restriction (BFR) training in pulmonary rehabilitation for COPD patients and its applicability from clinic to home settings. It reminds you that for patients with exercise intolerance or inability to perform high-load training, BFR training can achieve similar strength and endurance gains at low loads compared to high loads, making it an effective strategy to improve peripheral muscle function and overcome dyspnea limitations.
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述，而非原始研究，因此其结论是基于现有文献的综合，可能受到纳入研究异质性的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a review, not original research, so its conclusions are based on a synthesis of existing literature and may be influenced by heterogeneity of included studies.

items.title: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summary: An exploratory case-crossover study of 375 professional women's footballers found slightly greater match exposure (d = 0.21–0.37) and estimated travel distance (2724 ± 4821 km vs 2194 ± 4625 km, p < 0.001) during ACL injury seasons compared to control periods. No travel was associated with lower odds of injury, but effect sizes were small, indicating contextual patterns for further investigation rather than causality.
items.curatedReason: 这项对专业女子足球运动员的探索性研究表明，ACL 损伤季节的比赛暴露和估计旅行距离略有增加，但效应量较小。这提醒你在评估运动员 ACL 损伤风险时，要将比赛负荷和差旅因素纳入考量，但不能将其视为主要预测指标，需配合其他因素进行综合判断。
items.titleZh: 专业女子足球运动员 ACL 损伤前的比赛暴露和估计旅行：一项探索性队内病例交叉研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 375 名专业女子足球运动员进行的探索性病例交叉研究发现，ACL 损伤季节的比赛暴露（d = 0.21–0.37）和估计旅行距离（2724 ± 4821 公里 vs 2194 ± 4625 公里，p < 0.001）略有增加。未旅行与较低的受伤几率相关，但效应量较小，表明这些是需要进一步调查的背景模式而非因果关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study in professional women's footballers suggests slightly greater match exposure and estimated travel distance in ACL injury seasons, but with small effect sizes. This reminds you to consider match load and travel factors when assessing ACL injury risk in athletes, but not as primary predictors; a comprehensive assessment with other factors is needed.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性病例交叉研究，无法建立因果关系，且效应量较小，受试者间差异较大，限制了结果的直接临床应用。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case-crossover study, which cannot establish causality, and the small effect sizes with substantial inter-player variability limit direct clinical application of the findings.

items.title: BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice -
items.summary: The BJSM blog provides recent short articles on sports and exercise medicine, including hamstring strain injuries, traditional Chinese exercises for MSK disorders, CARTA algorithm for Achilles rupture, mSIT+ for concussion, and exercise guidelines.
items.curatedReason: BJSM 的这篇博客文章汇编了运动医学和骨骼肌肉健康的最新短文，但记住这只是一个概览。它适合你快速了解近期的热点话题，比如腘绳肌损伤、跟腱断裂算法和脑震荡评估，但要深究某个主题，你还得去查阅原始文献。
