It's useful for a quick catch-up on hot topics like hamstring strain injuries, Achilles rupture algorithms, and concussion assessment, but you'll need to chase down original sources for deeper dives.

items.title: CMS CRUSH Proposed Rule Aims to Reap Nearly $90 Billion for Taxpayers in Savings by Targeting Fraud Across Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace
items.summary: CMS has proposed the "Comprehensive Regulations to Uncover Suspicious Healthcare" (CRUSH) rule, aiming to save nearly $90 billion by targeting fraud across Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace.
items.curatedReason: CMS 提出的 CRUSH 规则旨在通过打击 Medicare、Medicaid/CHIP 和 Marketplace 的欺诈行为，为纳税人节省资金。这些规定将直接影响支付方和提供者的合规要求，你需要了解其细节以确保执业符合新规。
items.titleZh: CMS CRUSH 拟议规则旨在通过打击 Medicare、Medicaid/CHIP 和 Marketplace 欺诈行为，为纳税人节省近900亿美元
items.summaryZh: CMS 提出“揭露可疑医疗保健综合规定”（CRUSH）拟议规则，旨在通过打击 Medicare、Medicaid/CHIP 和 Marketplace 的欺诈行为，为纳税人节省资金。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS's proposed CRUSH rule aims to save taxpayers nearly $90 billion by targeting fraud across Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace. These regulations will directly impact compliance requirements for payers and providers, and you need to understand the details to ensure your practice adheres to the new rules.

items.title: Comprehensive Regulations to Uncover Suspicious Healthcare (CRUSH) Proposed Rule (CMS-6098-P)
items.summary: CMS has released comprehensive regulations to uncover suspicious healthcare (CRUSH) as a proposed rule (CMS-6098-P), outlining measures to target fraud.

items.curatedReasonEn: CMS-6098-P signals a tougher stance on healthcare fraud, and by extension, heightened scrutiny for all physical therapy practices involved in Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace. You must review every detail of this proposed rule and begin assessing its potential impact on your compliance, reimbursement processes, and daily operations.

items.title: Next-generation control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons: State-of-the-art, limitations, and future directions.
items.summary: This review summarizes current control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons used in gait rehabilitation, highlighting that existing methods are often unintuitive and insufficient for seamless, user-driven assistance, with future directions focusing on advanced user intent determination.
items.curatedReason: 了解下肢外骨骼的控制策略进展对理解其临床潜力与局限至关重要。当前技术尚存在瓶颈，未来需关注用户意图检测和自适应性，这会直接影响康复效果。
items.titleZh: 下肢外骨骼的下一代控制策略：现状、局限和未来方向
items.summaryZh: 本综述总结了用于步态康复的下肢外骨骼当前控制策略，指出现有方法往往不够直观且不足以提供无缝、用户驱动的辅助，未来方向将侧重于先进的用户意图确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding advancements in lower-extremity exoskeleton control strategies is crucial for grasping their clinical potential and limitations. Current technology still faces bottlenecks, and future developments in user intent detection and adaptability will directly impact rehabilitation outcomes.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: User Experience of a Rehab Community-Based, Affordable Robot Exercise System (Rehab CARES) for Gamified Motor and Cognitive Stroke Rehabilitation
items.summary: Six adults with chronic stroke using Rehab CARES, a community-based robot exercise system, reported low pain, light to moderate perceived exertion, strong and stable enjoyment, and high usability scores (86/100) for personalized motor and cognitive training.
items.curatedReason: 这款康复机器人系统 Rehab CARES 提供了积极的用户体验，显示出其在社区环境中为卒中患者提供个性化运动/认知训练的潜力，为你将机器人技术整合到康复方案中提供参考。
items.titleZh: 基于社区的可负担机器人运动系统（Rehab CARES）用于游戏化运动和认知卒中康复的用户体验
items.summaryZh: 六名慢性卒中患者使用基于社区的机器人运动系统Rehab CARES进行个性化运动和认知训练，报告疼痛感低、感知劳累度轻至中度、享受度高且稳定，以及可用性评分高（86/100）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Rehab CARES robot exercise system demonstrated a positive user experience, indicating its potential to deliver personalized motor/cognitive training to stroke patients in a community setting, offering a reference for integrating robotic technology into your rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 样本量较小（成人），且为慢性卒中患者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (adults) and focused on chronic stroke patients, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Use of Rehabilitation Therapy Services among World Trade Center Health Program Members with Cancer
items.summary: This study examines rehabilitation service utilization among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer certification from 2011-2024 to understand their needs.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提供了关于世贸中心健康项目成员中癌症患者康复服务利用的基线数据，为你了解该特定人群的康复需求和服务缺口提供初步参考。
items.titleZh: 世贸中心健康项目癌症成员康复治疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在考察2011-2024年间获得癌症认证的世贸中心健康项目成员康复服务利用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study provides baseline data on rehabilitation service utilization among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer, offering an initial reference for understanding the rehabilitation needs and service gaps in this specific population.

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Low-Level Laser Therapy in Patients With Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs found low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain (Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002) in carpal tunnel syndrome. Pulsed mode was superior for analgesia, while continuous mode better supported grip strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析证实了低强度激光疗法（LLLT）对腕管综合征（CTS）的疼痛和握力有显著改善，并明确了脉冲模式更利于镇痛，连续模式更利于功能恢复。你可以在 CTS 患者的治疗方案中考虑 LLLT，并根据治疗目标（镇痛或功能恢复）选择合适的激光模式。
items.titleZh: 低强度激光疗法治疗腕管综合征患者的比较疗效：随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入16项随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析发现，低强度激光疗法（LLLT）显著减轻了腕管综合征患者的疼痛（Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001）并改善了握力（Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002）。脉冲模式在镇痛方面更优，而连续模式则更有利于握力恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs provides strong evidence: for carpal tunnel syndrome, LLLT significantly reduces pain (Hedges' g=-1.524) and improves grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391). In clinical practice, consider incorporating LLLT, selecting pulsed mode for analgesia or continuous mode for grip strength improvement based on patient priorities.
items.limitation: 尽管荟萃分析证据等级高，但可能仍存在纳入研究间的异质性，且部分次级结局如CSA的改善不显著。
items.limitationEn: Despite the high evidence level of meta-analysis, heterogeneity among included studies may exist, and improvements in some secondary outcomes, like CSA, were not significant.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: From "Tech Fear" to Digital Self-Efficacy: A COM-B and TDF Analysis of Tele-Exercise Engagement in Older Adults at Risk of Falls
items.summary: A qualitative study embedded in an RCT found that tele-exercise is feasible and acceptable for 25 older adults at risk of falls, despite initial digital literacy barriers, with participants successfully engaging and fostering digital self-efficacy through targeted behavior change techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使老年患者在基线时数字素养较低，远程运动干预仍然可行且可接受，且依从性高。这提示你可以在跌倒风险老年人群中推广远程运动方案，不必过分担忧数字技术障碍，而应侧重于提供技术支持和个性化的行为改变技术。
items.titleZh: 从“技术恐惧”到数字自我效能：对跌倒风险老年人远程运动参与的COM-B和TDF分析
items.summaryZh: 一项嵌入随机对照试验的定性研究发现，远程运动对于25名有跌倒风险的老年人是可行且可接受的，尽管初始存在数字素养障碍，但参与者通过有针对性的行为改变技术成功参与并培养了数字自我效能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that telerehabilitation for exercise is feasible and acceptable for older adults at risk of falls, even with low baseline digital literacy, showing high adherence. This suggests you can promote tele-exercise programs in this population without excessive concern about digital barriers, focusing instead on technical support and tailored behavior change techniques.
items.limitation: 这是一项嵌套于RCT的定性研究，样本量较小（25名参与者），且结果基于对干预后的访谈，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study nested within an RCT, with a small sample size (25 participants), and results are based on post-intervention interviews, which may involve recall bias.

items.title: Education and training pathways for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists: a qualitative study investigating competency.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored advanced musculoskeletal practitioners' experiences with education and training in Tasmania, finding that current workplace-based training supports clinical expertise but lacks health-service collaboration, and highlighting opportunities for integrating external training and aligning policy and regulation to support competence.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了澳大利亚高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师在教育培训方面的系统性差距，强调了政策与监管亟需调整以支持能力提升。这提示你需要关注本地区（或借鉴澳大利亚的经验）PT 高级执业资格的认证与培训路径，并思考如何弥补培训需求与现有系统间的鸿沟。
items.titleZh: 高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的教育与培训路径：一项探讨能力的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了塔斯马尼亚地区高级肌肉骨骼实践者在教育和培训方面的经验，发现当前的工作场所培训支持临床专业知识但缺乏医疗服务协作，并强调了整合外部培训以及调整政策和法规以支持能力的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals systemic gaps in education and training for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists in Australia, highlighting the urgent need for policy and regulatory alignment to support competence. This prompts you to consider the certification and training pathways for advanced PT practice in your region (or learn from Australia's experience), and how to bridge the gap between training needs and current systems.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（12名参与者），结果主要反映塔斯马尼亚地区AMPs的经验。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (12 participants), reflecting the experiences of AMPs primarily in Tasmania.

items.title: The new body-as-machine: a response to Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott's "Diagnosing the body in physiotherapy".
items.summary: This response article acknowledges and critically reflects on a landmark contribution to critical physiotherapy scholarship, which traces the evolving concept of the body from mechanical to modulated, highlighting tensions in existing analyses and raising issues for future resolution.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评是对物理治疗学界对“身体即机器”的反思。它并不会改变你的临床操作，但能让你从理论层面更深刻地理解当前生物-心理-社会模式的局限与演变，从而更好地参与学科内部的批判性对话。
items.titleZh: 新时代的“身体即机器”：对Breedt、Tichenor和Barlott的“物理治疗中的身体诊断”一文的回应
items.summaryZh: 这篇回应文章对批判性物理治疗学术领域的一项里程碑式贡献进行了肯定和批判性反思，该贡献追溯了身体概念从机械化到调控化的演变，并指出了现有分析中的张力及未来需要解决的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically reflects on the "body-as-machine" concept in physiotherapy. It won't change your clinical practice, but offers deeper theoretical insight into the limitations and evolution of the biopsychosocial model, preparing you for critical discourse within the profession.
items.limitation: 这是一篇批判性述评，不涉及实证研究数据或临床干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a critical commentary and does not involve empirical research data or clinical intervention outcomes.

items.title: Physiological responses during high intensity interval training and moderate intensity continuous training in patients attending early cardiac rehabilitation.
items.summary: In early outpatient cardiac rehabilitation, low-volume high-intensity interval training (HIIT) elicited greater ventilatory, hemodynamic, and metabolic demands, including higher mean VO₂, %VO₂R, and blood lactate, than time-matched moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT) in 18 stable coronary artery disease patients, despite higher perceived exertion.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在早期心脏康复中，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在生理刺激方面优于时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT），即便患者知觉劳累程度较高。这意味着可以考虑将 HIIT 作为冠心病患者个性化训练处方的一部分，以期获得更大的生理效益。
items.titleZh: 早期心脏康复患者进行高强度间歇训练和中等强度持续训练时的生理反应比较
items.summaryZh: 在早期门诊心脏康复中，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在 18 名稳定冠心病患者中引发了比时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT）更高的通气、血流动力学和代谢需求，包括更高的平均摄氧量、最大摄氧量百分比和血乳酸，尽管患者的知觉劳累程度也更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that low-volume high-intensity interval training (HIIT) provides a greater physiological stimulus than time-matched moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT) in early cardiac rehabilitation, despite higher perceived exertion. This suggests considering HIIT as part of personalized exercise prescriptions for CAD patients to achieve greater physiological benefits.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心、样本量小的交叉研究（18 名患者），结果需大型多中心研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, small-sample (18 patients) crossover study, and its findings require validation by larger, multi-center studies.

items.title: Patient experiences with a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for knee disorders: a qualitative study in german orthopaedic care.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 German patients with knee disorders found high acceptance of a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for prehabilitation and continuity of care, valuing its flexibility and structured guidance, though challenges included personalization and integration without professional support.
items.curatedReason: 这项德国定性研究表明，膝关节疾患患者普遍接受数字健康应用（DiGA）作为物理治疗的补充，尤其在术前康复和持续护理中。它提醒你，在将这类工具整合到诊所实践时，应关注患者对个性化、可用性和专业指导支持的需求。
items.titleZh: 膝关节疾病患者对处方数字健康应用（DiGA）的体验：德国骨科护理中的一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名德国膝关节疾病患者的定性研究发现，患者普遍接受处方数字健康应用（DiGA）用于术前康复和持续护理，并重视其灵活性和结构化指导，但挑战包括个性化不足和缺乏专业支持下的整合问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This German qualitative study indicates that patients with knee disorders generally accept digital health applications (DiGAs) as a complement to physical therapy, particularly for prehabilitation and continuity of care. It advises you to consider patient needs regarding personalization, usability, and professional guidance when integrating such tools into clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（10 名患者），且仅限于德国的特定人群和系统，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (10 patients) and was limited to a specific population and healthcare system in Germany, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Changes in cervical muscle mechanical properties during orofacial motor tasks in individuals with and without chronic neck pain
items.summary: In 84 adults, orofacial motor tasks significantly altered cervical muscle mechanical properties (e.g., frequency, stiffness, relaxation time, creep) in sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles, regardless of chronic neck pain status. While the neck pain group showed lower absolute tongue pressure, task-related cervical responses did not consistently differ between groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，口面部运动会改变颈部肌肉的力学特性，在有或没有慢性颈痛的人群中都如此。尽管慢性颈痛组的舌压较低，但口面部任务对颈部肌肉的整体影响似乎相似。这加强了我们对颈部和口面部系统相互作用的理解，提醒你在评估颈痛患者时，别忘了检查口面部功能，它可能是一部分问题的来源。
items.titleZh: 慢性颈痛患者与健康个体在口面部运动任务中颈部肌肉力学特性的变化
items.summaryZh: 在 84 名成人中，口面部运动任务显著改变了胸锁乳突肌和斜方肌的颈部肌肉力学特性（如频率、僵硬度、松弛时间、蠕变），无论其是否有慢性颈痛。尽管颈痛组的舌压绝对值较低，但与任务相关的颈部反应在两组间并未持续表现出差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Orofacial motor tasks appear to alter cervical muscle mechanics, regardless of chronic neck pain status, though the chronic neck pain group did exhibit lower absolute tongue pressure. This bolsters the idea of functional interplay between the cervical and orofacial systems. When assessing neck pain, remember to screen for orofacial contributions; they could be part of the picture.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果外推性受限于所测量的特定肌肉和任务。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality, and generalizability is limited by the specific muscles and tasks measured.

items.title: Wearable Sensors Predict Exertion Without Changes in Pulse Rate for Frail End-Stage Kidney Disease Patients
items.summary: A study of 13 ESKD patients and 13 healthy controls found that multi-modal wearable sensors significantly improved the prediction of perceived exertion (RMSE 1.33) in ESKD patients, whose pulse rate alone was insufficient due to beta-blocker use and lower physical capacity, highlighting the need for distinct algorithms for this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了在衰弱的终末期肾病（ESKD）患者中，传统的脉率监测不足以预测运动劳累程度，而多模态可穿戴传感器能显著提高劳累预测的准确性。这提示你在为 ESKD 患者进行术前康复时，需要采用更先进、多维度的监测技术，而非依赖单一脉率指标。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴传感器在衰弱终末期肾病患者中无需脉率变化即可预测劳累
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 13 名终末期肾病（ESKD）患者和 13 名健康对照的研究发现，多模态可穿戴传感器显著提高了 ESKD 患者劳累程度的预测准确性（RMSE 1.33）。由于 ESKD 患者使用β受体阻滞剂且体能较低，仅依赖脉率不足以预测劳累，这凸显了为该人群开发独特算法的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that traditional pulse rate monitoring is insufficient to predict exertion in frail end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) patients, and multi-modal wearable sensors significantly improve exertion prediction accuracy. This suggests that when conducting prehabilitation for ESKD patients, you need to adopt more advanced, multi-dimensional monitoring technologies rather than relying solely on pulse rate.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（ESKD 组和对照组各 13 人），且为一项概念验证研究，结果的普适性需更大规模临床试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (13 participants per group for ESKD and controls) and is a proof-of-concept study, requiring larger clinical trials to validate generalizability.

items.title: Effectiveness of wearable and non-wearable biofeedback on knee biomechanics during functional tasks in anterior cruciate ligament injury prevention and rehabilitation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 24 studies found that biofeedback significantly reduced peak knee abduction angle (Hedges’ g = 0.52, 95% CI 0.06 to 0.98, p = 0.03) in ACL injury prevention, but no significant effects for other knee biomechanics, with low to very low certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 生物反馈在 ACL 损伤预防中，对减少膝外翻角度有显著但低确定性的效应。临床上应谨慎解读这些结果，并告知患者，在更确凿的证据出现前，生物反馈仍是辅助手段，不能替代核心力量和神经肌肉控制训练。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴和非穿戴式生物反馈对 ACL 损伤预防和康复中膝关节生物力学的影响：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含24项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，生物反馈在ACL损伤预防中显著降低了膝关节外展峰值角度（Hedges’ g = 0.52），但对其他膝关节生物力学参数无显著影响，证据确定性为低至极低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Biofeedback significantly but with low certainty reduces peak knee abduction angle in ACL injury prevention. Clinicians should interpret these results cautiously and inform patients that biofeedback remains an adjunctive tool, not a substitute for core strength and neuromuscular control training, until more definitive evidence emerges.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为低至极低，且多数研究质量受偏倚风险、不精确性和不一致性影响。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low, with most studies affected by risk of bias, imprecision, and inconsistency.
